title: Fix test mocking to prevent real SendGrid API calls
description: Tests in test_main.py that test non-dry-run mode can accidentally send real emails to SendGrid. The test test_uses_load_email_config_when_not_dry_run patches auxctmailer.main.SendGridEmailSender but the import happens before the patch context, allowing real API calls with credentials from .env file. This caused emails to be sent to example.com addresses from test fixtures, hurting SendGrid sender reputation with hard bounces.
design:
Fix the mock to patch at the correct level BEFORE module import:
1. Patch auxctmailer.mailer.SendGridAPIClient instead of patching the class after import
2. Move the import inside the patch context manager
3. Consider adding a pytest fixture that auto-mocks SendGrid for all tests
4. Add safeguard: check if TO address ends in @example.com and refuse to send
acceptance_criteria: Given tests run with real .env file present, when test_uses_load_email_config_when_not_dry_run executes, then no actual SendGrid API calls are made and test fixtures with @example.com addresses never reach SendGrid API

title: Fix test mocking to prevent real SendGrid API calls
description: Tests in test_main.py that test non-dry-run mode can accidentally send real emails to SendGrid. The test `test_uses_load_email_config_when_not_dry_run` patches `auxctmailer.main.SendGridEmailSender` but the import happens before the patch context, allowing real API calls with credentials from .env file. This caused emails to be sent to example.com addresses from test fixtures, hurting SendGrid sender reputation with hard bounces.
design:
Fix the mock to patch at the correct level BEFORE module import:
1. Patch `auxctmailer.mailer.SendGridAPIClient` instead of patching the class after import
2. Move the import inside the patch context manager
3. Consider adding a pytest fixture that auto-mocks SendGrid for all tests
4. Add safeguard: check if TO address ends in @example.com and refuse to send

Alternatively, use pytest's monkeypatch to set env vars BEFORE any imports that might trigger load_dotenv.
acceptance_criteria:
Given tests run with real .env file present
When test_uses_load_email_config_when_not_dry_run executes
Then no actual SendGrid API calls are made
And test fixtures with @example.com addresses never reach SendGrid API

Given any test in test_main.py
When pytest runs
Then SendGridAPIClient.send() is never called with real credentials
